name: InitEntryQueue
evidence: slot 0 of the 0x8F class: runs InitObject (func_00182C18), allocates the 0xA00-byte buffer (0x80 entries of 0x14 bytes, AddQueueEntry's) and sets the flag at 0x68

name: GetNodeAnchorAndHeading
evidence: by the node's class (0x7E, 0x73, 0x6E, 2, or none) computes a position and a heading angle (func_00205778 of a matrix row) and writes them through the two out pointers; the fallback is the owner's position lowered by 75

name: SetEntryQueueTargetNode
evidence: clears the bound object's goal (+0x554, +0x2538) for the old node at +0x54 and, for a new node, sets the goal flag and point +0x560 from GetNodeAnchorAndHeading raised by 125 and stores the node at +0x54; StartNextQueueEntry and UnbindEntryQueue call it

name: ReplaceQueueOnOffObject
evidence: switches the on-off object at 0x58: forces the old one to -1 with SetOnOffObjectForcedState and unregisters it (slot 7) if 0x5C is set; registers the new one (slot 6 unless attached), copies 0x3C into its 0x2D0 and forces state 1

name: StartNextQueueEntry
evidence: moves the entry queue's index (+0x40) to the next 0x14-byte entry, finds the entry's object by id (FindFirstObjectById) and starts the entry by its kind (twelve kinds, jtbl_0024B000): player states (SetPlayerState), anchors and headings (GetNodeAnchorAndHeading); AdvanceEntryQueue calls it

name: CheckQueueEntryDone
evidence: returns 1 when an entry queue entry has finished, by its kind (kinds 4 to 12, jtbl_0024B030): its time has passed, its animation stopped, the player reached the state it waits for; AdvanceEntryQueue stops at an entry whose state is 0 until it does

name: AdvanceEntryQueue
evidence: starts the first entry when the index at 0x40 is negative, then moves past entries whose state is 0 and that func_0017C428 starts, and retries the pending item at 0x48

name: DrivePlayerFromEntryQueue
evidence: ControlPlayer's call for a player bound to an entry queue: runs the queue's pending entry (+0x48) by its kind on the bound player (+0x3C), finding its object (FindFirstObjectById), turning towards its anchor (GetNodeAnchorAndHeading) and changing the player's state (SetPlayerState)

name: IsEntryQueueRunning
evidence: runs AdvanceEntryQueue and returns whether entries exist and the index at 0x40 has not reached the count at 0x34

name: ResetEntryQueue
evidence: unbinds the queue's object (UnbindEntryQueue) if one is set and clears the count at 0x34 and index at 0x40

name: BindEntryQueueToObject
evidence: stores itself at 0x2740 of the object, the object at 0x3C, sets the index to -1 and triggers script event 0x17; with the flag at 0x68 it also runs func_0016E0F0(4) and func_001DDA20

name: UnbindEntryQueue
evidence: undoes BindEntryQueueToObject: clears the on-off object, frees the item at 0x50, clears 0x2740 of the object and 0x3C, triggers script event 25 and with the flag at 0x68 runs func_0016E118(4) and func_001DDA50

name: AddQueueEntry
evidence: appends a zeroed 0x14-byte entry with the three words kind, b, c to the buffer at 0x6C, counts it at 0x34 and returns it; returns the dummy D_002BE478 once 0x80 entries are used
